question_no: Bonds & Guarantees, Loan Syndication, Agricultural Loans & Cash Collateral - Question 82
question: Unusual risk policies approved by MCC is limited to, the following: Exposures to director related accounts Exposures to politically exposed entities Exposures to gambling entities.
discussion: Selected Answer: B. MCC may approve other unusual risks as well.

question_no: Bonds & Guarantees, Loan Syndication, Agricultural Loans & Cash Collateral - Question 83
question: Under no circumstance can the periodic (annual) review be temporarily extended
discussion: Selected Answer: B. False — the periodic review CAN be temporarily extended under the defined tiers (up to 30 days via Business ED + Head of Risk, up to 60 days via DMD, and up to 180 days depending on exposure amount), per section 5.2.10.

question_no: Bonds & Guarantees, Loan Syndication, Agricultural Loans & Cash Collateral - Question 84
question: If total facilities exceed the Risk rating limit, is it alright to determine that the level purpose of the facilities are reasonable, that there is an effective process to ensure that actual OSUC remains within the Risk Rating limit?
discussion: Selected Answer: A. If Total Facilities exceed limit, approvers must ensure OSUC stays within limit (page 122).

question_no: Bonds & Guarantees, Loan Syndication, Agricultural Loans & Cash Collateral - Question 85
question: Is it right to state that the purpose and other terms and conditions may not be specified in the original approval of total facilities?
discussion: Selected Answer: A. For guidance limits, purpose may not be specified (page 62).

question_no: Bonds & Guarantees, Loan Syndication, Agricultural Loans & Cash Collateral - Question 86
question: Is it always in all situations that careful consideration must be given to the adequacy of collateral for additional exposure?
discussion: Selected Answer: A. Always consider collateral adequacy (page 62).

question_no: Bonds & Guarantees, Loan Syndication, Agricultural Loans & Cash Collateral - Question 87
question: Is it right to state that in the distribution of an underwritten position through assignment, the bank remains obligated in the event that the participants fail to fund.
discussion: Selected Answer: A. In assignment, bank may have recourse risk.
